newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Solvay denies interested in UCB.
newsitem.headline: Solvay denies interested in UCB.

text.p: Belgian chemicals group Solvay denied strongly stock market rumours it was interested in buying Belgian speciality chemicals and drugs group UCB.
"This is our Loch Ness monster. It comes up year after year and we can only add denial to denial," Solvay spokesman Paul Muys told Reuters on Thursday.
"With all the mergers in the pharmaceutical world we have seen, it is normal that this subject comes up again but I can only deny it 1,000 percent," Muys said.
He said Solvay was happy with both companies, which are controlled separately by descendants of Belgium's Solvay family through several holding companies, remaining "as they are".
